title: Bowen Island Sea Kayaking

services.name: by kayak
services.desc: Take one of our kayak lessons to increase your confidence, skill level, and most importantly, safety on the water. Learn how to paddle efficiently while keeping the kayak stable through our Intro to Kayaking course. Discover how to respond quickly and effectively in the event of a capsize on our Capsize Recovery kayaking safety course. Be confident in your ability to help yourself and your friends should a capsize occur. Lessons can help in many different ways, we are a small business, a lesson can be tailored to meet your needs. services.name: Sunset Tour
services.desc: This tour combines our Pasley Island Discovery Tour with our extremely popular Sunset Tour. The start time is later in the day and changes through the season so that the tour ends at sunset. The Pasley Island group is a beautiful archipelago of eight islands tucked between Bowen and the Sunshine Coast. Kayaking here is arguably the best Vancouver getaway in the Lower Mainland. A short drive from Snug Cove takes you to the west side of Bowen Island and Tunstall Bay Beach. This sunset kayaking tour is a totally unforgettable afternoon out and should be part of your west coast itinerary. services.name: SUP Rentals
services.desc: Bowen Island is the perfect place to rent a Stand Up Paddle Board! We have a small fleet of solid and inflatable SUPs for rent. Mannion Bay, next door to Snug Cove offers calm waters and two beaches ideal for paddle boarding. We have wet suits if you would like to rent one to keep you warm. A one hour rental is the most frequently booked duration, though you can rent a board all day if you like. Some of our boards are large enough for two paddlers at the same time, or even bring your furry friend! Every season we have guests who head out with a dog on board, just remember a personal flotation device for your hound! Staying on the island for a few days, we can rent a board for the duration
